objective: Adversarially audit the proposal to keep 60 logical shards while replacing shard-by-shard physical execution with a global/factorized engine.

decision.reason: It overestimated safe cross-shard gate-mask reuse, violated the active one-shard authorization contract if executed immediately, increased common-mode blast radius, and did not preserve a downstream-rematerializable event-mask carrier.

verified_findings.finding: The active campaign policy authorizes ONE_PREREGISTERED_GA1_SHARD_AT_A_TIME. Bulk execution of the remaining shards is not currently authorized.
verified_findings.root_cause: Scientific sequencing and physical scheduling are conflated in one authorization rule.
verified_findings.correction: Before any bulk execution, supersede the policy pre-PnL with a frozen batch-execution manifest that authorizes an exact immutable set while preserving per-domain outputs and the economic firewall.

verified_findings.finding: Family-mask outputs are carrier-coordinate-dependent and cannot be globally reused by family/variant alone.
verified_findings.evidence: CarrierMaskEngine inputs include source_idx, bar_idx, structural state and session timestamps; audited M2 t00 carriers had 128538 TICK coordinates versus 11078 CLOSE coordinates.
verified_findings.root_cause: The original proposal treated semantic filter identity as sufficient cache identity.
verified_findings.correction: Typed action key must include evaluator version plus full carrier/input artifact hashes and domain dependencies.

verified_findings.finding: Primary and NumPy global reducers are independent reductions of the same generated group artifacts, not independent event-mask generators.
verified_findings.evidence: Both consume groups_fast/groupXX class_occ.bin and full_alias_mapping.bin.
verified_findings.root_cause: Oracle independence begins too far downstream.
verified_findings.correction: Require independent generator parity on regression domains and stratified per-domain generator canaries before bulk promotion.

verified_findings.finding: FAST V2 group receipts do not bind DEV/bar/indicator/raw-cache identities, and reducers do not recompute group receipt self-hashes.
verified_findings.root_cause: Output-integrity checks are present but action provenance is not part of the reducer acceptance invariant.
verified_findings.correction: Every action receipt must contain an action_key=SHA256(op_version, code hashes, environment hash, domain, parameter bytes, all input artifact hashes); reducers must recompute receipt hash and require one frozen input-manifest root.

verified_findings.finding: Shard10 FAST V2 retains class/mask hashes but not exact unique event-mask bytes; direct downstream rematerialization therefore requires recomputation.
verified_findings.root_cause: Runtime-stall mitigation removed the durable scientific carrier that older mask-pack stages preserved.
verified_findings.correction: Persist either the canonical mask pack or a certified factorized IR sufficient to reconstruct every representative event mask and verify its domain-bound class hash.

verified_findings.finding: The exact M2 helper implementations executed are local-only; the durable completion receipt stores their SHA256 identities but not recoverable bytes/paths in GitHub.
verified_findings.root_cause: Prototype evolution occurred inside the runtime faster than code promotion.
verified_findings.correction: No production/campaign promotion may reference an executed helper unless its bytes are recoverable from a durable code bundle, commit, or immutable environment image.

verified_findings.finding: Shard10 completion is durable but the stable pointer/handoff still describe shard10 as authorized with only 9 completed shards.
verified_findings.root_cause: Target, pointer, handoff and completion are separate writes without one atomic authority transaction.
verified_findings.correction: Single authoritative frontier object plus CAS ref update; handoff becomes derived/non-authoritative. Prefer one Git tree/commit transaction for multi-file transitions.

verified_findings.finding: Fine-grained recovery multiplied orchestration state: M2 groups_fast contains thousands of files and hundreds of receipts.
verified_findings.root_cause: Checkpoint granularity was driven by chat/tool timeout rather than scientific transaction boundaries.
verified_findings.correction: Persistent executor with adaptive checkpoints; split only when measured runtime/memory crosses a threshold.

verified_findings.finding: Chunk restarts can recompute primitive family masks. For heavy t00 there are 1373 unique semantic primitive requests; treating all 38 chunks independently would evaluate 4656 request sets (3.39x), while the observed group01 process segmentation implies about 2484 (1.81x).
verified_findings.root_cause: Primitive caches are process-local rather than content-addressed carrier artifacts.
verified_findings.correction: Persist carrier-level primitive IR once; package chunks reference it.

verified_findings.finding: SQLite reduction is not the fastest deterministic representation for fixed-width records.
verified_findings.correction: Use bounded-memory sort/reduce as primary where resource envelope permits; retain an independently implemented oracle.

verified_findings.finding: GEOMETRY is the dominant algorithmic bottleneck because 79 parameter variants with active-trend dependencies recompute common numeric features as opaque gates.
verified_findings.root_cause: The filter compiler factorizes across families/packages but not algebraically inside parameterized families.

factorized_ir.interpretation: A certified carrier+primitive-bitmap+recipe IR can reconstruct exact class identities while being much smaller than fully materialized masks for tested cases.

geometry_algebraic_factorization.interpretation: GEOMETRY can be compiled from shared bar-space primitives and reused across CLOSE/TICK for identical asset/timeframe/fractal/tie without changing outputs.

replacement_architecture.name: QROS_GA1_COMPILED_TYPED_DAG_FACTOR_IR_V1
principles: Scientific shards remain immutable logical domains; physical execution is a compiled task graph.
Every task is content-addressed by operation version, typed parameters, code/environment identity and hashes of every input.

Safe shared primitives: asset DEV bytes, bars/indicators per asset/timeframe, structural states per asset/timeframe/fractal/tie, raw up/down crossing cache per asset/timeframe, global frozen filter-plan recipes.
Unsafe to share without carrier key: candidate masks, gate masks, session masks on candidate coordinates, side-dependent predicates, MTF candidate mappings.
Compile GEOMETRY and other threshold families into natural-coordinate primitives before carrier gather.

Persist factorized IR: carrier coordinates, membership bitmaps, primitive bitmap dictionary, semantic-key-to-physical-bitmap map, package recipes, class-to-representative recipe, config-to-class mapping.
Semantic class key remains domain-qualified; physical bitmap dedupe never merges hypotheses.
Use bounded worker processes/tiles, not one monolithic global process.
Use atomic immutable CAS publication and a single authority CAS transition.
Bulk remaining-shard execution requires an explicit pre-PnL policy supersession and immutable batch manifest.
Independent generator parity/canaries precede bulk execution; downstream reducer parity alone is insufficient.
what_it_obsoletes_if_validated: per-shard rebuild of reusable bars/indicator/raw-crossing caches
thousands of package-chunk receipt files in normal operation
mandatory full raw-mask pack materialization for every class
random SQLite alias/class updates on the hot path
serial authorize-run-promote loop for each frozen non-economic shard

red_team_of_replacement: Cache poisoning or stale reuse remains possible unless action key binds all inputs, code and environment.
A wrong compiler can corrupt many shards; require exact M12/M15/M2 regressions plus independent generator canaries before widening blast radius.
Factor IR corruption must be detected by object hashes and by reconstructing representative masks and checking domain-bound class hashes.
Physical bitmap dedupe must never imply semantic cross-domain dedupe.
Adaptive bitmap codec may change performance or serialization; canonical semantic mask remains sorted source-record indices, independent of storage codec.
Bulk scheduler must never expose partial economic outputs or permit result-dependent skipping/order.
Precomputed bar-space predicates must preserve bar_idx-1 and MTF completion semantics; future-perturbation metamorphic tests are mandatory.
regression_requirements: M15 exact structural roots/counts from durable PASS.
M2 exact structural roots/counts from durable PASS.
Independent direct-generator parity across all fractal windows, tie policies, CLOSE/TICK, RETEST modes and rearm modes.
SELL mirror canaries and XAU point-scaling canaries before bulk use.
Future perturbation: mutate data strictly after T; all signals/events <=T must remain byte-identical.
Input/receipt tamper tests must fail closed.
residual_risks: No full SELL/XAU validation of factor IR has been executed.
No full different-timeframe regression of the algebraic GEOMETRY compiler has been executed beyond M2.
Adaptive bitmap/Roaring representation is unvalidated in QROS.
Exact environment lock for Python/NumPy/Numba is not currently part of shard10 receipts.
Current stable pointer still lags the durable shard10 completion until a separate authority correction is committed.
next_automatic_action: Do not implement the rejected global-mask-sharing proposal. Freeze shard11. Persist an authority checkpoint acknowledging shard10 PASS and architecture-audit hold. Build the replacement DAG/IR engine only on an isolated research branch, bind environment/action keys, then regression-test it against M12/M15/M2 and independent generator canaries before any bulk remaining-shard execution.
